name: Band Press Sit-Up
steps: Anchor a resistance band low behind your head, lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, and hold the ends above your chest.
Brace your abs tightly while keeping light tension in the band.
Curl your spine smoothly up off the floor into a sit-up while pressing both hands forward and upward against the band.
Roll your torso slowly back down onto the floor as you return your hands above your chest.
tips: Keep steady tension in the band without letting it yank your arms back behind your head.
Control the lowering phase all the way down rather than collapsing onto the floor.
